candidates.claim: The VTY_MGMT ACL bound to the sw-ot-01 vty lines (0 4 and 5 15, SSH) permits 192.168.30.0/24 (CORP) at entry pos 1, which the management policy does not allow since device management must come only from MGMT 10.10.99.0/24.
candidates.remediation: Remove the permit 192.168.30.0/24 entry from ip access-list standard VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01 so that only 10.10.99.0/24 is permitted.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison reports one deviation: a permit entry was added to ip access-list standard VTY_MGMT on sw-ot-01 that is absent from the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added VTY_MGMT permit entry against the approved baseline by removing it or documenting an approved change.
